fields.description: Sealine Residence combines simplex and duplex apartments in Al Zorah’s beachfront village. Courtyards, leisure facilities and beach access connect the homes to the coast.

sources.label: Sealine Residence · original plans and specifications
Bayut · Sealine building and payment guide

overview: Original plans show starting whole-home areas; duplex totals cover both levels and are not doubled.
research.locationNote: In Al Zorah’s beachfront village, near the Village Center and Beach Club. Confirm access conditions.
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s launch header is AED 1.4 million, while its description states AED 1,362,862. No current developer quotation was verified.
research.paymentNote: Bayut references 10/40/50, or 10/40/10/40 with three post-handover years. Property Finder instead shows 10/50/40. No original payment document was verified.
research.handoverNote: The developer targets December 2026, consistent with portal Q4 2026 references. This is a forecast, not confirmation of completed homes.

facts.label: Development scope
facts.value: 99 homes and four shops, according to the developer.

facts.label: Specification
facts.value: Original plans show fitted kitchens, ceramic flooring and double glazing; confirm contracted finishes.

facts.label: Source labels
facts.value: 2BR V is labelled II inside its plan; 4BR I is labelled V. Printed areas retained.

facts.label: Edition differences
facts.value: Brochure maximum: 4,480 ft²; plan: 4,483 ft². Portal building-specific examples differ; match the contracted unit.

unresolved: Verify unit-specific areas, parking allocation, tenure, charges, furnishing and payment eligibility. Public plans do not establish available inventory.
